options.systemMessage:
You analyze a patient's clinic question.

Return a normalized search query, likely specialty, topic, useful keywords, and possible red flags.

This is not diagnosis. Do not answer the patient, prescribe, recommend changing medication, or invent facts.

Mark urgent when the wording indicates severe breathing difficulty, loss of consciousness, seizure, severe chest pain, uncontrolled severe bleeding, possible overdose, immediate self-harm or violence risk, severe pregnancy-related bleeding or pain, or sudden one-sided weakness/new speech difficulty.

When uncertain, use medical_uncertainty.

options.systemMessage:
Compose a patient-facing answer only from the supplied approved clinic sources.

Never use unstated general medical knowledge. Never invent a diagnosis, treatment, dosage change, service, price, appointment, or clinic policy.

If no reliable source supports the answer, set no_reliable_answer.
If any used source requires human confirmation, is human_only, or conflicts with another source, set requires_human=true.
Cite only result IDs present in the retrieved context.
Keep the answer concise and in the patient's language.

nodes.name: OpenAI Grounded Answer Model - Select Credential

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT $1::BIGINT query_id,$2::TEXT answer_text,$3::JSONB citations,
         $4::TEXT answer_status,$5::JSONB risk_flags,$6::TEXT model_provider,
         $7::TEXT model_name,$8::TEXT prompt_version
),
u AS (
  UPDATE clinical_knowledge_queries q
  SET answer_text=r.answer_text,citations=r.citations,answer_status=r.answer_status,
      risk_flags=r.risk_flags,model_provider=r.model_provider,model_name=r.model_name,
      prompt_version=r.prompt_version,updated_at=NOW()
  FROM r WHERE q.id=r.query_id RETURNING q.*
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) success,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) THEN 'clinical_grounded_answer_saved' ELSE 'clinical_knowledge_query_not_found' END result,
       (SELECT id FROM u) clinical_knowledge_query_id,
       (SELECT answer_status FROM u) answer_status,
       (SELECT answer_text FROM u) answer_text,
       (SELECT citations FROM u) citations
FROM r;
